# Sources for the SVG export bundle

`cytoscape-svg-0.4.0-source.tar.gz` contains Ilkin Safarli’s cytoscape-svg sources, webpack configuration and upstream GNU GPL version 3 license for release `v0.4.0` at revision `263e0be049a91e7a22d40b78f91ba7a9ef0e7ffb`. The JavaScript distributed in `src/vendor/cytoscape-svg.js` matches the npm 0.4.0 distribution byte for byte. [Upstream release](https://github.com/kinimesi/cytoscape-svg/tree/263e0be049a91e7a22d40b78f91ba7a9ef0e7ffb)

`canvas2svg-68b8ef8-source.tar.gz` contains the canvas2svg revision pinned by that release, including its MIT license and the Gliffy Inc. copyright notice. [Pinned source](https://github.com/kinimesi/canvas2svg/tree/68b8ef886ca066d07294d9ee3157f6a3a9e44599)

The source manifest records the upstream download URLs, revisions, SHA-256 digests and npm integrity value. [Source manifest](sources.json)
